cellEncoding: Each row expands operations into separate cells. Dialect grammarIdentity plus hostProfiles[hostProfile] supply the grammar/version, parser epoch, syntax profile, host/profile and source/config/build basis; each expanded cell has one resultClass, detail and evidence. Every listed operation occurs exactly once per host per dialect. Evidence is static current-source inspection and named existing tests, not a claim those tests or external engines ran in DIAL0.
